Caveat: candidate menus were full-window-designed (menu inflation not measured).

name: nested2_verdict_amended

Corrected frozen grade 2016 -> 2024-06-21 (443 weeks), same 4w/5y/top10/60-40/no stop/cap 2 config: $464 (+19.7%/yr, SR 0.94, DD 36%) vs SPY $307 (+14.1, 0.85, 32%).
